title: Download fails with QuotaExceededError in Safari
body:
Safari 26 on an iPad Pro (M4). The download of Qwen3 1.7B stops at around 40% with:

```
QuotaExceededError: The quota has been exceeded.
```

Retry starts again and fails at the same point. The smallest model (Qwen3 0.6B) works.
author: philippmossier
